titleVi: Mệnh đề quan hệ rút gọn
summaryVi: Bỏ who/which/that + to be: the man (who is) standing …; danh từ + V-ing / V3 thay cho mệnh đề quan hệ.

items.textVi: Chủ động: danh từ + V-ing (= who/which + is/are + V-ing).

example.en: The woman talking to Tom is my boss.
example.vi: Người phụ nữ đang nói chuyện với Tom là sếp tôi.

items.textVi: Bị động: danh từ + V3 (= who/which + is/are + V3).

example.en: The documents sent yesterday are confidential.
example.vi: Tài liệu gửi hôm qua là mật.

items.textVi: Chỉ rút gọn khi đại từ quan hệ làm chủ ngữ của mệnh đề.

example.en: The book (that) I bought is interesting. → không rút thành *The book bought I…
example.vi: Tân ngữ trong mệnh đề thì không rút kiểu này.

items.wrong: The people lived there were friendly.
items.right: The people living there were friendly.

items.wrong: The letter sending today is urgent.
items.right: The letter sent today is urgent.

exercises.prompt: The students ___ for the exam look nervous.
The bridge ___ last year connects two districts.
Anyone ___ (want) more information should email us.

exercises.instructionVi: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ
exercises.source: The man who is waiting outside is my uncle.
exercises.answer: The man waiting outside is my uncle.

exercises.source: The emails which were deleted cannot be recovered.
exercises.answer: The emails deleted cannot be recovered.

exercises.promptVi: Các sản phẩm bán chạy nhất nằm ở kệ đầu.
exercises.answer: The best-selling products are on the front shelf.

exercises.sentence: The girl [dance] on stage is my cousin.

exercises.prompt: The path ___ (lead) to the beach is steep.

exercises.instructionVi: Mở rộng thành mệnh đề đầy đủ
exercises.source: The tourists injured were taken to hospital.
exercises.answer: The tourists who were injured were taken to hospital.

exercises.promptVi: Ngôi nhà nhìn ra biển thuộc về gia đình tôi.
exercises.answer: The house overlooking the sea belongs to my family.

exercises.sentence: The rules [announcing] yesterday are now in force.
